answer: The quill counter is kept in summit and vertex publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An farming party hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Scaling to 462 identities multiplies that fee by 134 with no matching gain in influence. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
